name: Terrain blocks (p306)
description: p306 Phase 2's verification scene: three 100 m terrain blocks side by side, spawned with spawnTerrainBlock. Middle: the Gym's terrainSmooth.glb as a JSON-only block (an imported node, a HEIGHTFIELD read from its geometry, grass through its materialInputs' variant of textureSetSurface). Right: a generated block (the toolkit's noiseTerrain) with the generator's heightfield. Left: a generated block with a TRIMESH collider. Front (p306 Phase 4): a 64 m block from a committed .r16 heightmap (loadTerrainHeightmapAsync, generated on the toolkit's terrain worker with its heightfield), its heights checked against the map's texels. Front left (p306 Phase 5): the terrain add-on's orientation block, a 32 m Blender export with corner markers (snow at the engine's -x, -z corner, mud at +x, -z) and baked AO, twice: through its COLOR_0 and, beside it, through its painted splat map; both must look alike. A 3 × 3 grid of boxes falls on each. The tab (p306 Phase 4) spawns a fourth, a 256 m / 257² rulesTerrain block with AO behind them, and generates the same on the toolkit's terrain worker or the main thread, logging the frames. window.__terrainBlockTest holds the spawn results and, after the boxes settle, each box's height above the terrain under it.
